description: This file implements functions for handling YAML events including allocation, cleanup, cloning, creating, and extracting information from events within the libfyaml library. It defines the behavior for various event types like stream, document, mapping, sequence, scalar, and alias events, and manages memory through recycling mechanisms.

classes.name: fy_eventp
classes.description: A structure encapsulating a YAML event, including its type and associated tokens or state, with functions for allocation, clean-up, free, and cloning.

methods.name: struct:fy_eventp * fy_eventp_alloc(void)
methods.description: Allocates a new fy_eventp structure with default event type FYET_NONE.

methods.name: void fy_eventp_clean_rl(struct fy_token_list * fytl,struct fy_eventp * fyep)
methods.description: Cleans up tokens and state associated with an event, based on event type, using recycled token list if provided.

methods.name: void fy_parse_eventp_clean(struct fy_parser * fyp,struct fy_eventp * fyep)
methods.description: Cleans an eventp structure within the context of a parser, freeing tokens.

methods.name: void fy_emit_eventp_clean(struct fy_emitter * emit,struct fy_eventp * fyep)
methods.description: Cleans an eventp structure within the context of an emitter, freeing tokens.

methods.name: void fy_eventp_free(struct fy_eventp * fyep)
methods.description: Frees a fy_eventp structure after cleaning it up.

methods.name: void fy_eventp_release(struct fy_eventp * fyep)
methods.description: Alias for fy_eventp_free.

methods.name: struct:fy_eventp * fy_parse_eventp_alloc(struct fy_parser * fyp)
methods.description: Allocates or recycles an eventp structure for a parser.

methods.name: void fy_parse_eventp_recycle(struct fy_parser * fyp,struct fy_eventp * fyep)
methods.description: Recycles an eventp structure back to the parser's recycle list.

methods.name: void fy_parser_event_free(struct fy_parser * fyp,struct fy_event * fye)
methods.description: Recycles an event associated with a parser.

methods.name: struct:fy_eventp * fy_eventp_vcreate_internal(struct fy_eventp_list * recycled_list,struct fy_diag * diag,struct fy_document_state * fyds,enum fy_event_type type,va_list ap)
methods.description: Creates a new eventp with detailed parameters, or from a recycled list, initializing event data accordingly.

methods.name: struct:fy_eventp * fy_eventp_create_internal(struct fy_eventp_list * recycled_list,struct fy_diag * diag,struct fy_document_state * fyds,enum fy_event_type type,...)
